Searches for Lepton Flavor Violation in the Decays tau to e gamma and tau to mu gamma

comparison_policy.density: The sealed 27/5 ratio is compared with the complete outward Planck dark-to-baryon interval. The comparison-side central baryon density is also transported by 27/5 and tested against the complete cold-dark interval.
comparison_policy.galaxy: The admitted inverse-square law with a finite baryonic source is compared with the retained SPARC observed-to-baryonic velocity record; this distinguishes baryon-only asymptotics from an additional gravitating distribution but does not by itself identify a particle species.
comparison_policy.lfv: All three corresponding radiative search rows are retained. They are upper limits after null searches, not measured nonzero rates, so they cannot measure the sealed 3:5:20 relative-weight prediction. No absolute branching fraction is manufactured.
comparison_policy.smithion: The four spectra remain standing exact predictions because no penta/hepta Smithion has a registered measured mass. Existing absence is not relabelled as a measured mass or discovery.
